BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE
LAW REVISION ACT
(Chapter 1)
LAW REVISION ORDER NO.3 OF 2026
In exercise of the power conferred by section 5(1) of the Law Revision Act,
the Attorney General hereby makes the following Order -
Citation and commencement
1. This Order may be cited as the Law Revision Order No. 3 of 2026 and shall
commence on the day it is made.
Inclusion of pages
2. The inclusion in the Laws is hereby authorised of .the pages specified in the
third column of the Schedule hereto with reference to the written laws specified
in the first and second columns thereof and bearing on the face or overleaf the
legend specified in the fourth column thereof. .
